source.approvalSource: Direct root message: personally viewed allAve4+Mutsumi-left and MyGO5(Tomori/Anonv2,Rana/Soyo/Takiv1), static identity/simple whole vertical grip approved; clean/contacts pending personal128 review.

productionDecision.reason: Full source inspected. Raw tool black RGB preview can show broad bluecloud, but those RGB pixels are A0. Actual native-alpha composites on light/dark retain no broad visible halo. Do not regenerate mask or apply230..250 gate to already clean subject.
productionDecision.rgb: Only RGB under exactly zero source alpha normalized to0. Every source pixel with any alpha>0 keeps exact original RGB and alpha; no crop, resize, redraw, removal, outline/face/color change.
productionDecision.alpha: Native alpha byte-for-byte preserved, including low-alpha antialias and tiny A1 speckles. AlphaBounds truthfully includes those speckles; alpha>=8 bounds separately records practical visible silhouette.

verticalContact.anchorMeaning: Y is a personally observed main-torso placement reference; not an invented animated joint or same-height paw rule. X independently checked through all three actual source paw crops.
verticalContact.adjustmentReason: Previous rough line touched outer dark rim or missed white contact at middle/hind paw. Chosen source X moved inward to cross real gripping white areas of all three paws.
verticalContact.identityConstraint: No image flip; own-right gold/own-left blue eyes retained. Opposite direction needs independent art.

provenanceBoundary: Upstream character dossier/prompt/imagegen original belong to linked source record. This production makes no new art or character interpretation.

producerReview.observation: Personally viewed whole source, three actual native paw crops and128px-tall normal light/dark. No visible broad bluecloud; entire cat head/body/feet/tail and source antialias retained. Own source axis crosses upper/middle/hind gripping white regions.
